verses.1:
This is Solomon’s Song of Songs. + 1:1 Most translators add subheadings for speaker identifications such as The Bride , The Groom , and The Friends based on the gender and number of the Hebrew words. 
 The Bride
verses.2:
Let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth!
 For your love is more delightful than wine.
verses.4:
Take me away with you— let us hurry!
 May the king bring me to his chambers.
 The Friends
 We will rejoice and delight in you;
 we will praise your love more than wine.
 The Bride
 It is only right that they adore you.
verses.5:
I am dark, yet lovely, O daughters of Jerusalem,
 like the tents of Kedar, like the curtains of Solomon.
verses.6:
Do not stare because I am dark,
 for the sun has gazed upon me.
 My mother’s sons were angry with me;
 they made me a keeper of the vineyards,
 but my own vineyard I have neglected.
verses.7:
Tell me, O one I love,
 where do you pasture your sheep?
 Where do you rest them at midday?
 Why should I be like a veiled woman
 beside the flocks of your companions?
 The Friends
verses.8:
If you do not know, O fairest of women,
 follow the tracks of the flock,
 and graze your young goats
 near the tents of the shepherds.
 The Bridegroom
verses.9:
I compare you, my darling,
 to a mare among Pharaoh’s chariots.
verses.10:
Your cheeks are beautiful with ornaments,
 your neck with strings of jewels.
 The Friends
verses.11:
We will make you ornaments of gold,
 studded with beads of silver.
 The Bride
verses.12:
While the king was at his table,
 my perfume spread its fragrance.
verses.13:
My beloved is to me a sachet of myrrh
 resting between my breasts.
verses.14:
My beloved is to me a cluster of henna blossoms
 in the vineyards of En-gedi.
 The Bridegroom
verses.15:
How beautiful you are, my darling!
 Oh, how very beautiful!
 Your eyes are like doves.
 The Bride
verses.16:
How handsome you are, my beloved!
 Oh, how delightful!
 The soft grass is our bed.
 The Bridegroom
verses.17:
The beams of our house are cedars;
 our rafters are fragrant firs.

metadata.source: Derived from the Berean Standard Bible (BSB). Missing verses restored from the Textus Receptus tradition for completeness.
